judged_text: Store's plural hydration now processes all *_ids keys and calls _lookupSubType on each, potentially throwing or populating undefined entries for *_ids keys whose prefix isn't a registered client model, regressing unrelated pages

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6`, `_hydrateEmbedded` was expanded from matching only `*_id` to also matching `*_ids` via `/(.+)\_id(s?)$/`. For the plural case it blindly does `obj[k].map(...)` and always deletes the original `*_ids` key, replacing it with `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = hydrated`. If `obj[k]` is not an array (nil/string) this will throw, and if `_lookupSubType` can’t resolve the subtype, the resulting array will contain `undefined` entries while the original ids are discarded. The diff doesn’t prove such payloads exist on “unrelated pages,” but the lack of guards makes this a real edge-case/robustness issue introduced by the change.
